items.myth: Cream cakes can stay out of the fridge all day.
items.fact: Keep them cold until 30 minutes before serving; cream spoils fast in a warm room.

items.myth: More sugar makes a cake moister.
items.fact: Sugar holds moisture, but too much makes it gummy. Fat and correct baking time matter more.

items.myth: A cake is done when the top is golden.
items.fact: Check the middle: a skewer should come out with a few moist crumbs, not wet batter.
Wrapped well, a sponge freezes for a month and thaws soft in the fridge overnight.
